query-mapping.description: List of changes to report for notifications

property.name: date
property.comment: the date when the change was made.

property.name: kind
property.comment: the field name that was changed.

property.name: field
property.comment: the field name that was changed.

query.name: audit-list
query.comment: Get the list of changes made after some date
query.sql: SELECT audit.id, audit.date, audit.entity_type, field.name, audit.entity_id, audit.old_value, audit.new_value FROM awa_audit AS audit LEFT JOIN awa_audit_field AS field ON audit.field = field.id WHERE audit.id >= :last_audit
